name: Wee Ee Chao
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Wee Ee Chao, son of the late banker Wee Cho Yaw, is chairman of Singapore brokerage United Overseas Bank Kay Hian as well as chairman of Haw Par Corporation, maker of the popular Tiger Balm ointment.
He has spent  more than four decades growing UOB Kay Hian into one of the largest brokerages in Asia.
He replaced his father as Haw Par's chairman in 2024.
He was chairman of the Singapore Tourism Board for two years until 2004.
In March 2025, the estate of his father, the late Wee Chow Yaw, was transferred to him, his mother and siblings, completing a process that happened over many months.

name: Itzhak Ezratti
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026)
forbes_bio: Itzhak Ezratti cofounded GL Homes in 1976 with his father-in-law Joseph Hanin.
GL Homes, the initials of which stands for "Good Luck," is one of Florida's largest private home builders, having completed over 36,000 homes since its founding.
Originally from Israel, Ezratti immigrated to Washington, D.C., and worked as a bank teller before moving to Florida.
GL Homes gained momentum in 1992 after Hurricane Andrew hit south Florida. That year and the year following, the company sold about 1,000 homes.
Ezratti stepped down as president of the firm in 2016 but continues to serve as chairman. His son Misha now runs GL Homes as president.
forbes_facts: Ezratti and his father-in-law's first GL Homes project in 1976 was a single duplex in Hollywood, Florida.
GL Homes specializes in its housing communities for people aged 55 and over.

name: Kwee Liong Seen
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2023-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Kwee Liong Seen and his three siblings control privately held Pontiac Land, which owns an array of luxury hotels and iconic office towers across Singapore.
Pontiac Land was founded by their Indonesian father Henry Kwee, a textile trader and real estate developer, who migrated to Singapore in 1958.
In New York, the brothers own a majority stake in a luxury tower designed by French architect Jean Nouvel, located beside the Museum of Modern Art.
In 2017, the brothers acquired the Cappella Hotel group from legendary luxury hotelier, Horst Schulze, for an undisclosed sum.
Pontiac Land has invested $400 million in a resort complex in the Maldives.

name: Zhuang Kuilong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2018-2024); Hurun Global (2018-2026); Hurun China (2017-2026)
forbes_bio: Zhuang Kuilong is the former chairman of Xinfengming Group, a manufacturer of polyester and filament products.
Zhuang was reportedly a farmer before a joining a collective fiber factory.
He cofounded the predecessor to Xinfengming in 2000 with 11 others founders, including his wife Qu Fengqi.
Xinfengming listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2017.
His son Zhuang Yaozhong is the company's president and chairman.

name: Hajime Satomi
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2006-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Hajime Satomi is the chairman of Sega Sammy, a Japanese pachinko machine and gaming software firm.
He founded pachinko machine maker Sammy, which got into the videogame business when it acquired Sega in 2004.
His son, Haruki, is CEO and chairman.
Sega Sammy has a 45% stake in South Korean gambling-and-entertainment resort Paradise City.
Satomi is also a top-ranked owner of thoroughbred horses.

name: Lim Chap Huat
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2015-2026)
forbes_bio: Son of a rickshaw driver, Lim Chap Huat set up a small construction outfit with two partners in 1976 at age 22.
He expanded Soilbuild Group into property development and set up an REIT, eventually buying out his partners. His wife Leo Jee Lin and sons, Lim Han Feng and Lim Han Qin, work with him.
Soilbuild expanded into Myanmar in 2012 where it has multiple contracts, and into Vietnam in 2017.
In 2021, Lim, together with Blackstone Real Estate, privatized Soilbuild Business Space REIT, delisting it from the Singapore stock exchange.
In 2024, Lim and Blackstone sold their office and industrial properties in Singapore to New York-based private equity firm Warburg Pincus and Australian developer Lendlease for $1.2 billion.
forbes_facts: Lim taught part-time to pay fees for engineering school.
He is a firm believer in his school motto "Nothing Without Labour."

name: Yvonne Lo
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026)
forbes_bio: Yvonne Lo cofounded clothing manufacturer Crystal International Group with her husband Kenneth in 1970.
They have built a modest sweater factory into one of Asia's largest garment manufacturers, with 80,000 employees at 20 sites around the world.
Crystal's customers include Fast Retailing, Gap, Abercrombie & Fitch, Nike, Adidas and Puma.
Yvonne is vice chairman of Crystal. Kenneth is chairman while their son Andrew is CEO.
Kenneth is the eldest son of the late textile magnate Law Ting-pong.

name: Luiza Helena Trajano
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2019-2022); Hurun Global (2020-2025)
forbes_bio: Luiza Helena Trajano is chairman of retailer Magazine Luiza, which has nearly 1,000 stores in Brazil and a booming e-commerce arm.
She owns a bit more than 17% of the Sao Paulo-listed firm, which her parents founded in 1957 and named after her mother (also named Luiza).
Trajano was hired as an apprentice by her parents at age 18, working in different roles until she became CEO in 1991.
She led Magazine Luiza's expansion into online sales, a fast growing part of the business that now accounts for nearly 40% of revenues.
She handed off the CEO role to her son Frederico Trajano in 2015 and has been chairman of the board since then.

name: Wu Xushun
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2016-2026); Hurun China (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Wu Xushun is a cofounder of Wuhu Shunrong Sanqi Interactive Entertainment Network Technology in China.
Wuhu Shunrong Auto Parts, which is listed on the Shenzhen stock exchange, acquired 60% of Sanqi Interactive Entertainment Shanghai Technology in 2014.
Following the acquisition, Wuhu Shunrong Auto Parts was rebranded as Wuhu Shunrong Sanqi Interactive Entertainment Network Technology.
Wu dropped out of school after he finished middle high school in 1963. He was once a government official in Xitan in Nanling County in Anhui Province.

name: Ben Silbermann
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2016-2025); Hurun Global (2017-2026); Hurun Global U40 (2019-2022)
forbes_bio: Ben Silbermann is cofounder and chairman of the photo bookmarking site Pinterest.
Silbermann grew up in Iowa and collected dried insects which he then would pin on cardboard.
He and cofounders Evan Sharp and Paul Sciarra, launched the first desktop version of Pinterest in March 2010.
Pinterest lets its 570 million users save and share image collections from recipes to hairstyles to crafts and home decor through their mobile phones or computers.
Prior to cofounding Pinterest, Silbermann graduated from Yale, spent three years as a consultant and worked for Google before quitting to focus on a startup, Cold Brew Labs.
